_comment: AI City roster. Edit freely - the bridge reloads it on restart, and the tower rebuilds with however many floors this file (plus auto-discovered reporters) defines. `id` MUST match the cloud routine name exactly (underscores, not hyphens) or its floor will never light. Verified against the live RemoteTrigger list 2026-07-24. `at` is the ET shift time (HH:MM) used to order tower floors bottom-to-top and to light a floor during its shift window. `type`: daily | weekly | service. Weekly routines render as the penthouse boardroom. Unknown agents that report events get appended here automatically with discovered:true - rename them, don't delete them, or they'll just come back.
_cloud: All ten trading routines run as claude.ai cloud routines (RemoteTrigger / claude.ai Routines), NOT local scheduled tasks. Their cron expressions are in UTC; the `at` times below are the ET equivalents. They share the git repo github.com/AztecNightmare365/claude-trading-tasks and commit handoffs + trade_log.csv to it on every run.

agents.name: Overnight Desk
agents.role: Reads overnight positions and the after-hours update, scans overnight news, fetches pre-market prices, writes the overnight brief. Can place pre-market limit sells in catastrophic situations.

agents.name: Pre-Market Desk
agents.role: Pre-market data via Polygon, flags critical situations, writes the pre-market brief. Places no orders.

agents.name: Bell Desk
agents.role: Fires at the opening bell - enforces stops and take-profits against the open print, enters confirmed catalyst watch-list positions.

agents.name: Open Desk
agents.role: Main morning session: market regime gate, candidate sourcing via Polygon, order placement, handoff write.

agents.name: Midday Desk
agents.role: Midday reassessment and stop-trailing, may open new positions.

agents.name: Watch 1
agents.role: Stop-loss / take-profit monitor. Sells only - never opens positions.

agents.name: Watch 2
agents.role: Stop-loss / take-profit monitor. Sells only - never opens positions.

agents.name: Close Desk
agents.role: End-of-day: overnight hold/exit evaluation, final order placement, handoff to tomorrow's 10 AM desk.

agents.name: After-Hours Desk
agents.role: After-hours prices and earnings results, assesses AH exits, builds tomorrow's catalyst watch list, places AH limit sells.

agents.name: The Boardroom
agents.role: Saturday performance review - reads the trade log, computes per-dimension stats, writes LEARNED INSIGHTS back into the trading routines.

agents.name: Market Watch
agents.role: The tower's data feed - a cloud routine that reads the Robinhood account and commits city-state.json to the trading repo, so the city stays truthful even when this laptop is asleep.
